cohort: Women undergoing their first IVF/ICSI cycles
finding: Early r-ICSI had comparable pregnancy, delivery, and neonatal outcomes to IVF and ICSI in fresh cleavage-stage embryo transfer cycles, but reduced pregnancy outcomes in fresh blastocyst embryo cycles.
mod_finding: Early r-ICSI did not show a negative effect on the risk of preterm birth, Cesarean section, neonatal birth weight, and sex ratio.
